Subject: Update on Department Budget Request

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you for reviewing our recent budget increase request. We understand that the current proposal did not align with the company’s financial strategy, and we appreciate the feedback regarding the need for greater detail.

We are committed to supporting the company’s fiscal goals and would like to resubmit our request with a more comprehensive justification. The revised proposal will include a detailed breakdown of costs and concrete examples of the anticipated benefits to ensure it aligns with our strategic objectives.

We will share the updated document with you shortly for your review.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]

***

Priority Question Answer: Mount Olympus
